metadata.title: When you get 2 kills and act like you single-handedly saved the game in VALORANT
metadata.description:
Wait, how did I even get those kills?
My brain was on break but the game said YES.
Watch me pretend I’m the MVP of luck.
VALORANT logic, please explain!

Click if you ever lucked your way to glory!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckygamer #funnyclips #clutch
